node_definition.done_when: A new module imas_ambix/agent/watch_publish.py and a command imas-ambix agent publish-watch in cli.py, with options --output (default ~/public/imas-ambix/watch.json), --cadence seconds (default 300), --once, --record and --index (both passed to watch.watch_document): each iteration calls watch.watch_document in-process, adds two top-level keys to the returned dict, compute_seconds (the wall time of that call, a float) and published_at (the UTC ISO-8601 time to the second taken after the call returns and immediately before the temporary file is written), writes the JSON to a temporary file in the target's directory and renames it over the target with os.replace, and prints exactly one flushed physical line per iteration, for example '2026-10-02T17:30:00Z publish-watch wrote /home/ITER/mcintos/public/imas-ambix/watch.json compute_seconds=48.31 bytes=123456' on success or '2026-10-02T17:35:00Z publish-watch failed: database is locked' on failure, the failure text being the exception message with every newline replaced by a space; a failed iteration (watch_document raising, or the write or rename failing) leaves an existing target byte-for-byte unchanged and the loop continues to its next iteration; agent watch --json output is unchanged; tests in tests/test_agent_publish_watch.py, with watch_document stubbed and a frozen clock, assert the --once file content and both added keys, that a stub raising an error with an embedded newline prints one line and leaves a pre-existing target's bytes identical, that os.replace patched to raise leaves the target's bytes identical, that the loop with an injected sleep runs three iterations and prints three lines, and that the help names the default output path and cadence; gate: uv run --no-sync pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_agent_publish_watch.py tests/test_agent_ingest_cli.py tests/test_agent_watch_help.py passes, uv run --no-sync pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_agent_serve_registry.py -k agent_package_modules_parse_with_serving_python passes with exactly 1 test selected, uv run --no-sync ruff check imas_ambix tests exits 0; the gate log's first line names the commit it ran at, each command is logged verbatim beside its own summary line and exit status as EXIT=N, and the gate runs in the foreground to its summary before the manifest is finalised
